scope: bounded component: current-query selection from two earlier named facts
selection: Existing composed System 1 with resolved founder genes; no parameter search. These are development founders, not fresh confirmation seeds.
boundary: Transient neural state and working trace reset at each trial; the same learned parameters persist. The trace is held during each present-state solve. No continuing-life or sentence-generation claim.
teaching: One local final-query lesson per case per round; earlier observations receive no labels or fabricated rewards. Finite default teaching phases have their own contract; each published action is qualified.
interpretation: The exposed arm receives both witnessed facts, never the selected answer. Its overall, unequal-fact and per-query accuracy must reach the acquisition floor before a trace failure is localized to retention or selection. This gate alone does not establish general relevance learning.
